title: KAGRA World dump
description: JSON from World.dump() / World.load(), ingested by kagra-shared WorldDoc (not Scene3D). Scene3D is a one-frame draw list; WorldDoc::compile_scene builds it (heightfield batches from named fn or samples, glTF via gltf_load, sprite/quad XY cards, torus rings, capsule player, metal coins, lights slot=0..3). Prop pitch/roll and local parent TRS (up to 4 links) are picture-only; position stays world-space unless local is true. WorldPlay ticks title→play→result (WASD, pick up, count, finish). render_world_doc (shared wgpu 30 offscreen) draws that frame to RGBA. python -m kagra.play_world is the official Crest collectathon window. Stable string ids, not GPU mesh integers. Live Python height_fn cannot dump; named demo fn or samples. RendererV2 stays for leftover VRM demos only.

genre.description: Explicit genre id (crest_isle, fish_cast, town_gate, …). Omit = free world: walk / camera / interact / timers / events only. Prop names are never reserved.

profile.description: Derived by WorldDoc::to_json_with_profile or splice_profile after a rendered frame. to_json omits it. from_json ignores it. warnings lists phone-budget misses (16.7 ms, 200 draws, 100000 triangles, 48 MB textures).

coordinates.description: Derived by WorldDoc::to_json / kagra.annotate_dump. from_json ignores it. Right-handed, Y up. World +X is screen-right only when the camera looks toward -Z.

note.description: States that D / ArrowRight / +lx means screen-right, and that a chase camera looking along +Z has screen_right = -X.

ibl.description: Diffuse IBL strength. Omit = 0.35 (outdoor). 0 = off. Shared wgpu 30 shader Globals.env.x; not a 4K HDR cubemap.

tonemap.description: ACES tonemap. Omit = on. Globals.env.w. Reinhard is not used; ACES matches kagra-core V2.

quality.description: Picture tier. Omit = historical picture (KAGRA_QUALITY=high still fills omitted SSAO, TAA, cascades, and PCSS, and does not turn bloom on). low / 0 / off forces SSAO, TAA, DOF, motion, extra cascades, and PCSS off even when those fields are set. mobile fills omitted fields with SSAO radius 4, TAA off (FXAA stays), 2 cascades, PCSS off, and bloom 0.22. high fills SSAO 8, TAA, 3 cascades, PCSS, and bloom 0.35. An explicit field wins over mobile and high. KAGRA_QUALITY=0 / off / low still forces the floor.

bloom.description: Bloom intensity on render_world_doc. Omit = 0, unless quality is mobile (0.22) or high (0.35). Env KAGRA_QUALITY=high does not turn bloom on. The desktop window example keeps its own default until a dump sets a grade field.

vignette.description: Vignette strength. Omit = 1 (the historical curve). 0 = off. Above 1 darkens the corners further.

lut.description: Display LUT preset after ACES: off, warm, punch, cool. Omit = off. A 16^3 strip, texture_2d, WebGL2 safe.

lut_strength.description: Mix toward the LUT, 0..1. Omit = 1 when lut is set.

fxaa.description: FXAA on the composite. Omit = on. Ignored while taa is on.

ssao.description: Half-resolution SSAO radius in pixels. Omit = off. KAGRA_QUALITY=high uses 8 when omitted. KAGRA_QUALITY=0 forces off.

taa.description: Temporal AA. Omit = off, except KAGRA_QUALITY=high. Replaces FXAA. Vignette then runs after TAA.

dof_focus.description: DOF focus distance in meters. Used when dof_aperture is set. Omit with no aperture = off.

dof_aperture.description: DOF aperture. Omit or 0 = off. The high quality tier does not force this on.

motion_blur.description: Camera motion-blur shutter, 0..1. Omit or 0 = off. A still camera does not smear.

shadow_softness.description: Directional shadow radius. Omit = 1, the historical 3x3 PCF. About 2.5 to 4 uses a wider 5x5 tent.

shadow_cascades.description: Cascades packed into the one 2048 sun map. Omit = 1, the historical full map (24 m). 2 or 3 use concentric rings (8 / 24 / 80 m) as tiles. KAGRA_QUALITY=high or 2 selects 3 when omitted. 0 / off / low forces 1.

shadow_pcss.description: Contact-hardening blocker search. Omit = off. The compare sampler stays the lighting path. High quality turns it on. KAGRA_QUALITY=0 / off / low forces it off. WebGL2 reads a color copy of device z because a comparison depth cannot be sampled as a value.

hemi_sky.description: Hemisphere sky, linear. Omit = studio blue (0.48, 0.56, 0.78), the SH the shader used to hardcode.

hemi_ground.description: Hemisphere ground, linear. Omit = studio warm (0.42, 0.30, 0.18).

env_map.description: Prefiltered specular. preset:studio bakes a lat-long from the hemisphere. A PNG path is an equirect, blurred into 4 roughness rows (64x64 texture_2d). Omit = SH specular, so an old dump does not change.

cull.description: Register mesh bounds and drop props outside the camera. Omit = draw every prop.

prop_lod.description: Distance where a non-vegetation prop becomes one billboard quad. Omit = full meshes. Vegetation keeps heightfield.lod_radius.

sky.description: Clear + fog RGBA. Omit = outdoor [130, 165, 205, 255]. Indoor rooms dump a dark color.

ground.description: Auto grass plane when there is no heightfield. Omit = true. Indoor rooms dump false and place their own floor.

timers.description: Generic countdowns. WorldPlay::start_timer / tick_timers. On 0, on_done is emitted as an event and active flips false. Cooking wait, fishing cast→bite, cooldowns.

events.description: Named happenings. WorldPlay::emit_event aggregates by name; take_events consumes. Multiple systems (score, UI, save) read the same event from the dump — no callback bus.

joints.description: Rapier impulse joints (physics feature). name is fixed / revolute / spherical. Anchors are body-local. Omit when empty.

points.description: GPU point sprites. Each position is a camera-facing quad (WebGPU point-list is 1px). size is the radius in meters. color is sRGB. Omit when empty. Not the CPU Emitter props.

lines.description: GPU fat lines. Each polyline is screen-space quads. width is pixels. color is sRGB. Omit when empty. Not the CPU Trail quads.

pitch.description: Nose up, radians. Omit = 0. Intrinsic Y (yaw), X (pitch), Z (roll).

roll.description: Bank, radians. Positive lifts local +X. Omit = 0.

model.description: box/sphere/capsule/plane/sprite/quad/torus/ring. torus|ring is an XY ring (hole along +Z). sprite|quad is a standing XY card. name target = FPS range hitscan (look + fire + hit). name tower + waypoint + creep = TD lane (path walk, tower hit, leak/clear). name finish + split = race drive (steer+throttle, lap/finish). name opponent = fight round (J/click attack, hitstun, KO).

texture.description: Repo-relative PNG path. compile_meshes attaches albedo on box/plane/sprite/quad. Alpha < 0.5 is discarded.

uv_scale.description: Repeat the albedo this many times (CPU tile; sampler stays ClampToEdge). Omit = [1, 1].

parent.description: Parent prop id. With local=true, position/yaw/pitch/roll/scale are parent-space (up to 4 links). Without local, parent is a link only and position stays world-space.

local.description: True = TRS is in parent space. Omit = false (world space), so existing parent links do not move.

metallic.description: Coins dump 1.0. Shared compile_scene uses Material::Metal.

emissive.description: Unlit HDR add so bloom can come from this prop. Omit = 0. Color is emissive_color, or the albedo when that is omitted.

emissive_color.description: Linear 0..1 RGB glow. Omit = use the albedo.

roughness_map.description: PNG path or preset:worn / preset:split / preset:brushed. G channel replaces the roughness scalar. Presets also write metallic.

metalness_map.description: PNG path or the same presets. B channel replaces the metallic scalar.

emissive_map.description: PNG path or preset:core. Multiplies the emissive color. Strength stays on emissive.

interact.description: Interaction metadata (talk / use / examine). None = plain scenery. on_use emits an event when the player presses J/attack in reach.

body.description: Rapier body: static / dynamic / kinematic. Omit = is_static (default static).

collider.description: box / sphere / capsule / cylinder / cone / none. Omit = infer from model.

sensor.description: True = overlap events only. Omit = false.

mass.description: Dynamic mass in kg. Omit or 0 = collider density.

color.description: sRGB r, g, b and opacity. Omit = white.
sRGB r, g, b and opacity. Omit = white.

type.description: joint, or the joint name if name is empty.

kind.description: talk | use | examine. HUD glyph/color can key off this.

prompt.description: Short HUD label while in reach (水辺, cast).

on_use.description: Event name emitted when used (e.g. cast). WorldPlay::step_interact emits it with {prop, name} payload.

reach.description: Horizontal reach in world units. Default 2.5.

remaining.description: Remaining seconds. WorldPlay::tick_timers counts down while active.

on_done.description: Event name emitted when the countdown completes (e.g. bite).

active.description: False = parked. A game starts it via start_timer / the use event.

model.description: Same dump key as prop.model. Capsule fallback when no glTF.

gltf.description: Same dump key as prop.gltf. Skinned glTF 2.0 / .glb / .vrm (glTF-binary + VRM 0/1 extras). CPU-skinned into Vertex3 on play_world. Capsule if missing.

clip.description: Seconds into the walk clip. 0 = rest / T-pose. Advances while WASD walking.

anim.description: Current animation state: idle / walk (engine-derived from wish) or a genre-set name (cast, reel, hit) that survives while standing. Dump-visible so the game state machine reads it without an engine hook.

expression.description: Selected VRM expression preset: blink (auto) / smile / angry / sad / joy / aa / ih / ou / ee / oh / custom. Dump-visible; games flip it via events / interact.

scale.description: Draw scale. Omit = (1, 1, 1). Squash and stretch write this on the picture dump. The walker sim does not read it.

screen_right.description: Derived. World-space unit vector toward the right edge of this camera's frame (forward × up). Present on to_json dumps; from_json ignores it.

screen_left.description: Derived. Opposite of screen_right. Present on to_json dumps; from_json ignores it.

albedo_ok.description: False when a leftover loaded tile has missing/1x1 albedo or no mesh while GPU tex is set (bald leftover).

fn.description: Named demo height_fn: island_height / overworld_height / open_world_height. Live Python fn cannot dump.
